description: At a wedding party in a muddy field under a grey sky, a young woman in a white chef's jacket, a stained apron and green rubber boots carries a tall four-tier white wedding cake high above her head on a board, stepping carefully through deep mud. A herd of black and brown cows crowds around her, one stretching its nose towards her. An overturned shopping trolley lies in the mud, and guests in suits and dresses watch from a wooden platform in front of a white marquee with bunting.
